    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # The most common color is the background; the two edge bars share a color.

    bg = Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bars = []
    for r in (0, h - 1):
        vals = [c for c in range(w) if g[r][c] != bg]
        if vals:
            lo, hi = vals[0], vals[-1]
            bars.append((r, lo, hi, g[r][lo]))
    if len(bars) != 2:
        return g
    (r1, a1, b1, color1), (r2, a2, b2, color2) = bars
    pts = [(r, c, g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if g[r][c] != bg and g[r][c] not in (color1, color2)
           and r not in (r1, r2)]
    if len(pts) != 1:
        return g

    shift = a2 - a1
    c2 = c + shift
    near_row = r1 if abs(r-r1) <= abs(r-r2) else r2
    step = 1 if near_row > r else -1
    rr = r + step
    while rr != near_row:
        if g[rr][c] == bg:
            g[rr][c] = marker
        rr += step
    if 0 <= c2 < w:
